Class AdventureCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.adventurecards.AdventureCard
Direct Known Subclasses:
AbandonedShipCard, AbandonedStationCard, Enemy, EpidemyCard, MeteorRainCard, PlanetCard, SpazioAperto, StarDustCard, WarZoneCard
public abstract class AdventureCard extends Object
The AdventureCard class represents an abstract base class for specialized adventure cards in the game. It provides a framework for the card's description, level, name, and state. Various methods are defined to handle specific actions and behaviors related to the card's effects, states, and interactions with the game board and players.

    • drawCard

      public void drawCard()
      Changes the current state of the adventure to the "DRAW" state, simulating the action of drawing a card. Updates the current player to the first connected player on the game board and prints a message indicating the name of the card that has been drawn.

    • landingOnStationOrShip

      public void landingOnStationOrShip(boolean isLanded) throws IllegalMethodOnThisStateException
      Handles the landing process either on a station or a ship, depending on the current state. Throws an exception if the method is invoked in an incorrect state.
      Parameters:
      isLanded - a boolean value indicating if the landing action is completed (true if landed, otherwise false)
      Throws:
      IllegalMethodOnThisStateException - if the current state is not DECISION_LAND_STATION_OR_SHIP

    • landingOnPlanet

      public void landingOnPlanet(boolean isLanded, int planetId) throws IllegalMethodOnThisStateException
      Handles the action of landing on a planet. This method ensures that the current state of the game allows for landing on a planet and throws an exception if the operation is not valid in the current state.
      Parameters:
      isLanded - Indicates whether the landing action is successful or not.
      planetId - The unique identifier of the planet being landed on.
      Throws:
      IllegalMethodOnThisStateException - If the method is invoked in an invalid state.

      public void rollDices() throws IllegalMethodOnThisStateException
      Rolls two six-sided dices, calculates their sum, and applies the result to the current effect. Throws: - IllegalMethodOnThisStateException if the method is invoked in a state other than ROLL_DICES.
      Throws:
      IllegalMethodOnThisStateException

    • applyEffect

      public void applyEffect()
      Applies the effect associated with the current AdventureCard. This method checks the current state of the AdventureCard to ensure it is in the EFFECT state. If the current state is not EFFECT, an IllegalMethodOnThisStateException is thrown to indicate that the method is being called in an invalid state.
      Throws:
      IllegalMethodOnThisStateException - if the current state is not EFFECT

    • appendTextWithWrapping

      public void appendTextWithWrapping(StringBuilder sb, String text, int width)
      Appends the provided text to the given StringBuilder, formatting it with line wrapping to fit within a specified width. If the text contains a prefix (e.g., before a colon), it preserves the prefix for the initial line and wraps the remaining content to subsequent lines with a continuation prefix.
      Parameters:
      sb - the StringBuilder to append the formatted text to
      text - the text to be appended, formatted with wrapping
      width - the maximum line width, including any prefixes and margin

    • disconnectionHandling

      public void disconnectionHandling(Player player)
      Handles the case where a player disconnects during specific game states. If the current game state matches one where player input is required and the disconnected player is the current player, a default effect is applied. Otherwise, no action is taken.
      Parameters:
      player - the player whose disconnection is being handled
